water_evidence: No source-derived spectral water class established on these sheets. No global white/blue exclusion is applied: both are real mapped legend colors. Hydrographic linework is not interpreted into separate water polygons; water vs similar lithologic fill may remain ambiguous. Native alpha is restricted to the map neatline and unchanged Kazakhstan boundary.
credit: USSR Ministry of Geology / Kazakh SSR Ministry of Geology; Central Kazakhstan series; native historical author and institutional credits preserved in complete source plates. Aerogeologiya, Moscow 1981 print; catalog series 1978. Via geokniga.org.
source_rights: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
